title: Japanese-Style Jamaican Duck Legs
description: A fusion dish that combines the bold flavors of Jamaica with the precise techniques of Japan. This recipe results in tender, juicy duck legs with a sweet and tangy glaze.

ingredients.name: Yummy Sauce (see notes)
ingredients.notes: A sweet and sour mixture of equal parts honey and rice vinegar, with a dash of soy sauce

ingredients.name: Sour Cherries (optional)
ingredients.notes: Canned or fresh, for added flavor and texture

ingredients.name: Jamaican Spices (e.g. allspice, thyme, scotch bonnet pepper)

instructions: Rinse the duck legs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the yummy sauce, olive oil, sour cherries (if using), Jamaican spices, and tagine spices.
Place the duck legs in a shallow baking dish and brush the sauce mixture evenly over both legs.
Bake the duck legs for 20 minutes, then reduce the heat to 375°F (190°C) and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the meat is tender and the skin is crispy.
Let the duck legs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
